description: This file defines C function interfaces (FFI) for TPM functionality, intended for use by Rust code with some utility functions and include guards.

methods.name: tpm_hmac
methods.description: Provides an external-accessible version of the TPM HMAC function, returning 0 on success and 1 on error.

methods.name: secure_env_log
methods.description: Logs security environment messages with specified severity, file name, line number, tag, and message.
